name: Special Seashell item line procs Pocket Tide on direct Frost or Nature damage (#8192)
contract: Every Special Seashell (base 415059, dungeon and Zul'Gurub tiers on 312991, higher tiers on 316991 and 320991) equips a proc dummy that triggers its Pocket Tide haste buff. The dummies' DBC records carry ProcFlags 0, and the world had no spell_proc rows, so the auras never registered a proc handler and the trinkets never procced, no matter how long a Witchdoctor cast Malefic Arrow at a dummy.

The dummies' tooltips promise a $h% chance when dealing direct Frost or Nature damage, with a 30 second internal cooldown. The repair gives each dummy the landed done-spell masks (69904: melee, ranged, none and magic damage classes), restricted to damage spells of the Frost and Nature schools (mask 24) at the hit phase, 12% chance and a 30000 ms cooldown.

Malefic Arrow 801674 is direct Nature damage of the ranged damage class, so it raises DONE_SPELL_RANGED_DMG_CLASS with the Nature school and must proc the trinket; the reporter's casts never did. Periodic ticks are deliberately not proc events, because the tooltips say direct.

The loaded proc entries are asserted directly: spell_proc_chance reads the tooltip's 12, and a landed Nature direct event procs each equipped dummy aura at about 12%, while a periodic event and an unlanded cast-phase event each proc it zero times. Before the repair the auras have no proc entries at all, so the chance lookups fail and every rate reads 0.
A trinket-less control carries neither dummy aura.
